verdict.rationale: Isaac ROS offers ready-to-use, plug-and-play packages for common behaviors such as navigation, perception, manipulation and object detection. Isaac Sim ships pip-installable Python namespace packages, and Isaac Lab includes bundled robot assets. However, nothing documents a browsable registry or ecosystem of reusable modules for physical hardware such as sensor or actuator drivers, so the hardware half of the story is only implied by simulation assets. Missing for 10: a documented registry or catalog to search and pull packages from, reusable hardware driver modules for common devices, and independent or hands-on corroboration of the package workflow.

support.subject: As a developer, I can pull reusable packages or modules from a registry or ecosystem for common hardware and behaviors

citations.quote: It offers ready-to-use packages for common tasks like navigation and perception
Plug and play with a selection of packages for computer vision, image processing, robust object detection, collision detection, and trajectory optimization
Deploy perception, localization, mapping, manipulation, teleoperation, and AI inference using production-ready ROS packages optimized for NVIDIA platforms.
Isaac Lab is developed with specific robot assets that are now Batteries-included as part of the platform
Isaac Sim provides several Python namespace packages that allow you to compose an Isaac Sim app by parts using a Python package manager (for example: pip).
